calculator_script_strategy: Reference `pricing calculator` <script> ported as a per-locale `<script is:inline define:vars={{ vars: scriptVars }}>` in PricingCalculator.astro (mirrors the existing ContactForm.astro define:vars pattern). The reference CT[lang]/lang-cs/lang-en toggle wiring is fully removed — each Astro locale is a separate static page so `lang` is fixed. define:vars cannot serialize functions, so cars(n) (cs auto/auta/aut vs en car/cars) and saving() are re-implemented in the script body branched on the injected `vars.locale`; only string/number data crosses the boundary (composed tierLabels per code, saveTemplate with an {x} placeholder, indiv word, +/- aria-labels, range min/max/initial + licPerDriver/appFee constants). kc() (U+00A0 thousands + U+00A0 Kč) and the savings derivation `saving(kc(cmp - price).replace('\u00a0Kč',''))` are preserved verbatim. SSR initial values (cars=3 -> small tier, 1 490 Kč / 3 297 Kč / Ušetříte 1 807 Kč) are pre-rendered in HomeSections so the no-JS render is correct; the client script re-derives on load and on input/stepper. Tier labels composed from tier.* keys with the reference ' · ' (U+00B7) separator.

verification.pricing_renders_both_locales: pass — dist/index.html + dist/en/index.html both carry id="calc-cars" and all four data-tier values (small/medium/large/custom). CS: SSR 'Malá flotila · do 3 aut', '1\u00a0490\u00a0Kč', compare '3\u00a0297\u00a0Kč', 'Ušetříte 1\u00a0807\u00a0Kč měsíčně', '3 auta'; injected script has Czech Ušetříte/individuálně/Ubrat auto/Přidat auto. EN: 'Small fleet'/'Medium fleet'/'Larger fleets'/'Large fleet' titles, 'Most common choice', 'In every plan', 'How many cars do you run?', 'You save 1\u00a0807\u00a0Kč a month', injected script has English You save/individually/Remove a car/Add a car. Zero Czech pricing strings leak into /en/ (12-string scan all 0).

notes: CSS scope ownership (per advisor): .calc* rules are scoped in PricingCalculator.astro; the .tiers/.tier*/.price-foot/.incl/.price-terms rules + the 1000/860/520px breakpoints + .tier.is-active live in HomeSections' existing <style is:global> block because the tier articles + price-foot render in the composition (scoped hashes would not match). The client script toggles .is-active on .tier[data-tier] document-wide regardless of CSS scope. Three keys NOT in the assignment's enumerated list were added to satisfy AC#4/AC#6 (no hardcoded localizable copy incl. aria): calc.saveTemplate, calc.minusAria, calc.plusAria (indiv reuses tier.customPrice). Two CSS pitfalls fixed mid-run: (1) a literal '/* pricing */' inside a CSS comment prematurely closed the block (esbuild css-syntax warning) — reworded, twice. (2) advisor caught that the #calc-tier / #calc-saving pills are raw spans (the script updates them by id; Pill.astro takes no id prop), so Pill.astro's SCOPED .pill rules never reached them — they rendered unstyled (build-green, grep-invisible). Fixed by porting .pill/.pill-accent/.pill-success into PricingCalculator's own scoped <style> (same cid as the spans -> .pill[data-astro-cid-nrsofeet] confirmed in bundled CSS) with white-space:normal so the long composed tier label + savings sentence wrap inside the result panels. compareNote/switch/sms prose money uses regular spaces per the reference source (prose, not a formatted price widget); the formatted price widgets (calc-price, cmp-price, tier-price, saving amount) use U+00A0 per rules/web-react-style.md#dates-and-money. pricing.ts replaced the old {featureKeys,termKeys,ctaKey} shape with a typed PricingTier[] model + calculatorConstants + includedFeatureKeys + termKeys; components map over data. Deviation: PricingList.astro deleted (no remaining importers, confirmed by grep). No web/, api/, Base.astro, or faq.ts touched (those are WI-1/WI-3). reference/index.html untouched.
